tasks.name: Classify Objects By Language
tasks.instruction: Put pepper objects into the left basket, chocolate_bar objects into the middle basket, and watch objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
tasks.instructionZh: 按指令把三类物体分别放入左、中、右三个篮子，然后让机械臂归位。

tasks.name: Solve Equation
tasks.instruction: Complete the equation by selecting the correct missing number or operator and placing it on the pad, then reset the robot arm.
tasks.instructionZh: 从桌面的数字和运算符中选出能让算式成立的缺失项，放到空白垫子上，然后让机械臂归位。

tasks.name: Play Tic Tac Toe
tasks.instruction: Play tic-tac-toe as the first player and fill the board with the opponent.
tasks.instructionZh: 作为先手与对手轮流落子，直到九个格子全部填满。

tasks.name: Arrange Largest Number
tasks.instruction: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
tasks.instructionZh: 将数字从左到右排列，组成可能的最大数字，并放到垫子上。

tasks.name: Build Tower
tasks.instruction: Build a tower using the wooden blocks and wooden boards.
tasks.instructionZh: 使用木块和木板搭建一座塔。

tasks.name: Cover Blocks
tasks.instruction: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
tasks.instructionZh: 从左到右盖住方块，记住颜色，然后按红、绿、蓝的顺序揭开。

tasks.name: Fold Clothes
tasks.instruction: Fold the clothes neatly.
tasks.instructionZh: 把衣服整齐地折叠好。

tasks.name: Hang Mugs
tasks.instruction: Hang all the mugs on the mug rack.
tasks.instructionZh: 把所有杯子挂到杯架上。

tasks.name: Imitate Sorting Sequence
tasks.instruction: Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
tasks.instructionZh: 观察并记住物体摆放顺序，然后按相同顺序把对应物体放入篮子。

tasks.name: Insert Key
tasks.instruction: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.
tasks.instructionZh: 拿起钥匙，交给另一只手，插入锁孔并转动。

tasks.name: Insert Tubes
tasks.instruction: Insert the three tubes into the rack one by one.
tasks.instructionZh: 依次把三根管子插入架子。

tasks.name: Make Toast
tasks.instruction: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
tasks.instructionZh: 拿起两片面包放进烤面包机，然后按下压杆。

tasks.name: Pack Objects Into Box
tasks.instruction: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
tasks.instructionZh: 把所有物体正面朝左放入盒子。

tasks.name: Pick From Conveyor By Image
tasks.instruction: Select the object on the conveyor that matches the image on the board, pick it up, and put it into the basket.
tasks.instructionZh: 选择传送带上与板上图像匹配的物体，拿起后放入篮子。

tasks.name: Play Stacking Toy
tasks.instruction: Place all stacking toy pieces onto the correct pegs.
tasks.instructionZh: 把所有套叠玩具片放到对应的柱子上。

tasks.name: Plug In Charger
tasks.instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.
tasks.instructionZh: 把充电器插入电源排插。

tasks.name: Pour By Language
tasks.instruction: Pour the liquid from the first violet bottle into the first black bowl, from the second red bottle into the second white bowl, and from the third turquoise bottle into the third brown bowl. Then reset the robot arm.
tasks.instructionZh: 按指令将三瓶液体分别倒入对应的三个碗中，然后让机械臂归位。

tasks.name: Pour Liquid Into Cup
tasks.instruction: Pour the liquid from the bottle into the cup.
tasks.instructionZh: 把瓶中的液体倒入杯子。

tasks.name: Press By Number
tasks.instruction: Press the two red buttons the required number of times according to the number cards, then press the blue button to confirm.
tasks.instructionZh: 根据数字卡要求按压两个红色按钮，然后按蓝色按钮确认。

tasks.name: Push T
tasks.instruction: Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.
tasks.instructionZh: 推动 T 形方块，使其精确对齐灰色 T 形垫。

tasks.name: Put Bottles Into Dustbin
tasks.instruction: Pick up the bottles and throw them into the dustbin, using handover when needed.
tasks.instructionZh: 拿起瓶子并将它们扔进垃圾桶，需要时在双手之间交接。

tasks.name: Sort Nesting Dolls By Size
tasks.instruction: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
tasks.instructionZh: 从左到右按从小到大的顺序排列五个套娃。

tasks.name: Stack Blocks
tasks.instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures.
tasks.instructionZh: 把三个不同纹理的方块叠起来。

tasks.name: Stack Bowls
tasks.instruction: Stack the three bowls together.
tasks.instructionZh: 将三个碗叠放在一起。

tasks.name: Store Tools In Toolbox
tasks.instruction: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
tasks.instructionZh: 把每件工具放入工具箱中对应的位置，然后让机械臂归位。

tasks.name: Sweep Blocks
tasks.instruction: Pick up the broom, hand it over to the right hand, then use the dustpan to sweep the blocks.
tasks.instructionZh: 拿起扫帚交给右手，然后用簸箕把方块扫起来。
